title: Nidus, which is developing AI-powered tech for manufacturing robots used by US defense industrial companies, raised $30M across a pre-seed and a seed (Alex Konrad/Upstarts Media)
summary: Alex Konrad / Upstarts Media: Nidus, which is developing AI-powered tech for manufacturing robots used by US defense industrial companies, raised $30M across a pre-seed and a seed — The startup backed by Kleiner Perkins and Costanoa says it's reached “seven figures” in bookings with defense industrial customers in just 4 months.
